metadata.description: A personal learning OS for Claude Code + Obsidian: a domain-agnostic course/paper ingest framework with machine-verifiable feedback loops, plus swappable domain plugins (chemical engineering ships as the reference implementation). 通用学习操作系统框架：领域无关的课程/论文流水线 + 可替换的领域插件。

plugins.name: claudesidian-notes
plugins.description: Framework layer — study pipeline for ANY subject: lectures become step-by-step teaching notes with self-checks and script-verified examples; distill first-principles formula maps; reverse-audit solutions; then build an exam review vault and quiz yourself with concept-level mastery tracking. 通用课程流水线：讲解型笔记 → 公式图谱 → 复习库 → 测验。

plugins.name: chemeng-coursework
plugins.description: Domain plugin (reference implementation) — chemical engineering coursework companion: decision-first problem coaching, a ChemE plotting library (ternary/McCabe-Thiele/psychrometric...), and docx polishing. Shows how to build a domain plugin on the framework. 领域插件参考实现：化工作业助手。

plugins.name: paper-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Framework layer — literature-review pipeline: PDF → vision-checked markdown → structured data extraction into a master spreadsheet. Domain-agnostic mechanics, shipped with an ionogel-review example. 文献综述流水线（机制通用，附离子凝胶示例）。
